This professional medium-capacity unit ensures every facial protocol or body treatment begins with impeccably sanitized, soothing hot towels.

settings.subtitle: Engineered for Precise Thermal Hygiene & Medium Station Efficiency
settings.secondary_description: Mechanical dependability and thermal containment are central to the Equipro engineering approach. The enamel-coated metallic chassis and aluminum interior chamber resist oxidation, corrosion, and residue buildup, ensuring decades of reliable commercial operation.

settings.heading: Key Features for the Professional Station

settings.text: Place the Hot Cabi on a sturdy treatment cart or countertop and connect it to a dedicated 120V clinical power supply.
Moisten up to 12 facial towels (13" x 24"), wring out excess water thoroughly, roll them neatly, and arrange them inside the internal wire basket.
Close the cabinet door securely and toggle the power switch to start automatic 80°C (176°F) thermal heating and active UV germicidal sanitation.
Retrieve warm towels as needed during facial or body protocols, ensuring the door is promptly closed to retain internal temperature.
At shift completion, turn off the unit, remove unused towels, empty the condensation tray, and wipe down internal surfaces until completely dry.
Never insert soaking wet towels into the cabinet; excess water accumulation can damage internal electrical heating elements.
Always verify towel warmth or use thermal tongs when retrieving items directly from the cabinet to prevent accidental skin discomfort.
Avoid prolonged direct visual contact with the active UV lamp during opening to protect eyesight.
